items.author: Ambreen
items.text: I had the best experience, Lindsay made me and my friends and family feel so so welcome and calm after a morning apppointment at a different shop that had been pretty stressful! She made the experience really fun and relaxed, was super efficient at getting me in and out of dresses quickly so I could maximise my time and I ended up finding my dress. Thank you for the best experience, we all had such a fab day 🙂

items.author: Alison
items.text: After attending a few bridal appointments in Glasgow and the surrounding areas, I feel I can confidently say that the dresses at The Bridal Courtyard are 'next level' in both style and quality. Owner Lindsay has impeccable taste and this is seen in all the dresses available in her boutique... I literally cannot thank Lindsay enough for all her help – my wedding dress was a 'wild card' picked by Lindsay herself... I could not recommend The Bridal Courtyard enough! I literally have found the dress of my dreams!

items.author: Katie
items.text: I cannot recommend The Bridal Courtyard highly enough! From the friendly and speedy pre-appointment communication to the warm welcome on arrival to the shop, I knew I'd gone to the right place... Lindsay created a wonderful experience... Oh and she also ensured Prosecco and tissues were to hand!

items.author: Laura
items.text: Such a beautiful store and the ladies truly make us feel so special. Compared to a lot of other bridal stores and boutiques, what stood out to us was the complete lack of judgement and pressure when you walk in. Not to mention we found the perfect dress as well! Would definitely recommend!

items.author: Ciara
items.text: Lindsay is the nicest person to deal with and goes over and above her job role. She is so welcoming, caring and knows exactly how to make people feel. We found the perfect dress for my sister at very short notice and she did everything to accommodate her.

items.author: Jess
items.text: My experience at Bridal Courtyard was honestly the best ever. Lindsay is so welcoming and friendly. The dresses and the store are just beautiful. She took the time to get to know me and truly made me feel so amazing. An absolute must place to visit when you are bridal shopping!

items.author: Jennifer
items.text: Would thoroughly recommend The Bridal Courtyard. Lindsay is absolutely amazing at what she does and made me feel so at ease... The space itself is beautiful, with lots of natural light and stunning dresses to choice from.
